auditProgramTemplates.name: Revenue & Trade Receivables Audit Program
auditProgramTemplates.description: Standard substantive audit testing program for revenue recognition, debtor circularisation, and cut-off verification under ISA 240 / 315 / 505.

procedures.title: Debtor Confirmation Circularisation
procedures.objective: Confirm existence and accuracy of year-end trade receivables balances with third-party debtors.
procedures.instructions: Sample key accounts above performance materiality and circularise positive confirmation requests; reconcile signed client confirmations.

procedures.title: Substantive Analytical Procedures on Revenue
procedures.objective: Corroborate reported revenue against monthly sales volume, contract pricing, and seasonality trends.
procedures.instructions: Perform monthly variance analysis and compare gross margins across product lines against prior year benchmarks.
procedures.requiredEvidenceType: Monthly revenue ledger and billing analytics

procedures.title: Year-End Sales Cut-off Testing
procedures.objective: Verify revenue and cost of sales are recorded in the proper accounting period.
procedures.instructions: Select 15 sales invoices and delivery notes immediately before and after year-end date; verify shipping terms.
procedures.requiredEvidenceType: Shipping documents and post-year-end credit notes

auditProgramTemplates.name: Cash, Bank & Financing Audit Program
auditProgramTemplates.description: Comprehensive audit procedures for cash, cash equivalents, bank reconciliations, and debt covenants under ISA 500 / 505.

procedures.title: Bank Balance Confirmation Certificates
procedures.objective: Obtain direct independent bank confirmations for all operative and dormant accounts.
procedures.instructions: Request bank certificates confirming balances, security charges, guarantees, and authorised signatories as of year-end.

procedures.title: Bank Reconciliation Clearance & Outstanding Items
procedures.objective: Verify accuracy and validity of year-end bank reconciliations and timing differences.
procedures.instructions: Inspect year-end bank reconciliation; test reconciling items and trace unpresented cheques to post-year-end bank statements.
procedures.requiredEvidenceType: Year-end bank statement and subsequent clearing evidence

auditProgramTemplates.name: Property, Plant & Equipment Program
auditProgramTemplates.description: Physical inspection, ownership verification, additions testing, and depreciation recalculation procedures.

procedures.title: Fixed Asset Additions & Vouching
procedures.objective: Verify capital additions exceed capitalisation threshold and are properly supported.
procedures.instructions: Select sample of asset additions exceeding QAR 10,000; inspect purchase invoices, title deeds, and capital approvals.
procedures.requiredEvidenceType: Vendor invoices and ownership title documentation

procedures.title: Depreciation Recalculation & Useful Life Review
procedures.objective: Verify depreciation expense complies with accounting policies and rates.
procedures.instructions: Perform independent recomputation of depreciation by asset class; test for fully depreciated assets still in service.
procedures.requiredEvidenceType: Fixed asset register and recomputation schedules

auditProgramTemplates.name: Purchases, Payables & Accruals Program
auditProgramTemplates.description: Search for unrecorded liabilities, supplier statement reconciliations, and expense accruals testing.

procedures.title: Search for Unrecorded Liabilities
procedures.objective: Detect unrecorded liabilities or understated trade payables at reporting date.
procedures.instructions: Review bank payments and unpaid vendor invoices for 45 days after year-end; examine matching goods received notes.
procedures.requiredEvidenceType: Subsequent bank payments and unvouched vendor invoices

procedures.title: Supplier Statement Reconciliations
procedures.objective: Verify trade payables balance agrees to external supplier statements.
procedures.instructions: Obtain year-end statements from top 10 suppliers by volume; reconcile differences to invoices in transit.
procedures.requiredEvidenceType: Vendor account statements and reconciliation workpapers
